channel.title: Riddle Minute: Number and Logic Riddles
channel.description:
One-minute number and logic riddles for puzzle lovers. Hear the riddle, pause and think, then hear the answer and why it works. Good for car rides, classrooms and family dinners.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Number Puzzles: Sumbriska, a quiet, clever iPhone number puzzle where every bridge you flip brings an island closer to its sum. Number Puzzles: Sumbriska on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.

item.title: The bat and the ball
item.description:
A bat and a ball cost one dollar and ten cents in total. The bat costs one dollar more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Number Puzzles: Sumbriska, a quiet, clever iPhone number puzzle where every bridge you flip brings an island closer to its sum. Get Number Puzzles: Sumbriska on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.

item.description:
